design_decisions.q6_split: Q6 auto-fix is proved in two halves because one fence cannot prove both without destroying shared state: ac2 proves repair-without-destruction (a PRESENT venv is not wiped, proven by a sentinel file, and foreign listeners are reported not killed), ac3 proves detect-then-rebuild (a MISSING venv is rebuilt and the whole tree proven functional: win32-native python, alembic head 005, installed frontend). The card says so in prose so the split is not mistaken for a gap.
design_decisions.ctrl_c: win32 cannot deliver a real console Ctrl+C from this harness (process.kill SIGINT is TerminateProcess so the handler never runs; SIGBREAK is ENOSYS). The contract is therefore pinned at the source level (ac4 requires process.on SIGINT and SIGTERM registration in scripts/dev/dev.ts) and at the outcome level (ac4 requires zero listeners after teardown; ac5 makes stop the guaranteed reaper), with the keypress itself as an explicit manual DoD line.
design_decisions.w8: ac3 measures wall clock in the harness AND requires the script to self-report an elapsed=N line, then parses that reported value against the 600s floor - so a 999s run fails the leg, and the artifact carries the evidence rather than only the exit code.
